title: Like John o’Gaunt his name is dear to him
html_source:
John of Gaunt, Duke of Lancaster, named after his birthplace of Ghent. In Richard II, Act II, Scene 1, Shakespeare has the character of Gaunt play with the double meaning of his name:

O how that name befits my composition!
Old Gaunt indeed, and gaunt in being old:

Shakespeare can likewise use “will” in all its various meanings
